name: Project Indicators Report2
query:
SELECT 
    pr.name AS project_id,
    p.name AS proposal_id,
    l.name AS logframe_id,
    l.acheivement,
    l.target,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.target IS NOT NULL AND l.target != 0 THEN 
            ROUND(CAST(l.acheivement AS DECIMAL(18,4)) / l.target * 100, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS achievement_percentage
FROM 
    `tabTFD Projects` pr
JOIN 
    `tabTFD Main Proposal` p ON p.project = pr.name
JOIN 
    `tabTFD Logframe` l ON p.log_frame_name = l.logframe_name
    AND l.type = 'Ind'
ORDER BY 
    pr.name, l.name;
